👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston Cocacola aur pepsi duniya ke sabse khatarnak companies hai!! Aur ye jab bhi kisi desh me jaate hai, us desh ke bade bade soft drinks brands khatam kr dete hain!! Kyuki in dono brands ke pass hazaro karodo ki money power, distribution expertise aur itne strong marketing teams hote hai!! Ki aate hi woh bade bade celebrities ke sath patnership krke market capture kr lete hain!! Aur India aate hi in dono brands ne aisi domination dikhai ki inke aage, campa cola, double 7 aur citra koi bhi tik nahi paayaa!! Lekin in dono ke money power ke samne sirf Ek Brand tik paya and that was and still is the iconic Thums up!!

Infact, Coca-Cola ne Thums Up ko khareeda hi isliye tha taaki usey mitti mein mila sake! Ye ek sochi-samjhi 'corporate strategy' thi. Lekin thums up ek aisa product nikla jisne market ko hilkar rakh diya!! Lekin unhe kya pata tha ki wo ek drink nahi, balki ek Toofan ko khareed rahe hain! Thums Up itna crazy product nikla ki aaj Coca-Cola aur pepsi dono se bhi market me Thums up bikta hai!!

Toh savaal ye hai ki itne paise aur celebrity power ke samne jab bade bade brands fail hogye, toh thums up kaise thik paya? Ramesh Chauhan ne aisa kya kiya ki aaj thums up India me market leader ban chuka hai? Aur is cola wars se hum kya sekh skte hai sekhenge is episode me?
